stories.headline: Kimi Antonelli clinches the Formula One drivers' title
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli finished third at the Mexico City Grand Prix, and that was enough to clinch the Formula One World Drivers' Championship. He is the youngest driver to take the title, and the first Mercedes driver to win it since 2020. Max Verstappen won the race, with Lewis Hamilton second.

stories.headline: Golden State win the WNBA title in a first game seven
stories.summary: The Golden State Valkyries beat the Atlanta Dream four games to three to win the WNBA title, the first championship in the franchise's history. The series was the first of any kind in the league to go to a seventh game. Gabby Williams was named the finals' Most Valuable Player.

stories.headline: Kévin Aymoz takes the men's title at Skate Canada
stories.summary: Skate Canada International, the second event of this season's ISU Grand Prix of Figure Skating, was held in Kelowna, British Columbia. Kévin Aymoz of France won the men's event and Mao Shimada of Japan the women's. Lia Pereira and Trennt Michaud took the pairs title for Canada, and Lilah Fear and Lewis Gibson the ice dance for Great Britain.

stories.headline: Trees straighten themselves with a wood that pulls
stories.summary: Researchers laid young poplar trees on their side. As the trees grew, their stems curved upward and lifted their tops back towards vertical, a response that depends on a specialised wood called tension wood, which pulls as it develops. By removing the directional signals that gravity and light provide, the team isolated the internal sense behind it: proprioception.
